I fished in this river for three years,

yet never knew the fish were all
transmigrators from the Lower Realm.

The carp I casually ate
are all great tonics.

It's because this is a River of Time —
every ascendant must cross it to enter
another realm.

Anyone entering the River of Time is
forcibly turned into a fish and drifts
aimlessly.

I transmigrated and became an
administrator of the River of Time,
but had no idea about it myself.
One day,

a young man in blue-star casual clothes
sailed slowly past me on a small boat.

My eyes widened instantly — does this
outfit match mine? Another transmigrator?

Seeing that, I immediately
chased after him.

The young man on the boat was terrified
when he saw someone swimming in the river.

Junior, you've accidentally
intruded upon my territory.
Please forgive me and spare my life.
Who are you?
How did you get here?

I'm Han Pan, an old
woman from a small place.

I accidentally wandered into
this area — please forgive me.
You don't even know where you are?

Then how did you end
up rowing a boat here?
Where are you going?

Han Pan absolutely can't admit
to being a transmigrator.
As an outsider from another world,

she must never reveal
her identity to locals.

I still want to ask the
senior — what is this place?

Oh, look at those two characters on the
boat's planking — can't you see them?
